head: ER-Golgi vesicle trafficking
name: ER-Golgi vesicle trafficking (COPI budding, Golgi-to-ER retrograde transport, vesicle targeting)
rationale: All members concern vesicle traffic between ER and Golgi; COPI budding and retrograde transport separate it from the COPII/ER-export and tethering neighbours.

head: Sensorimotor behaviour and motor control
name: Sensorimotor behaviour and motor control (locomotion, proprioception, glycinergic inhibition)
rationale: Members are neural control of movement and sensation (locomotion, reflexes, touch, vision, inhibitory transmission; one neural RNA-binding module is a loose fit); glycinergic inhibition and proprioception separate it from the exploratory/vocal behaviour and neuronal excitability neighbours.

head: Gonadotropin and GnRH signaling
name: Gonadotropin and GnRH signaling (FSH, LH, glycoprotein hormone receptors)
rationale: Members are cellular responses to GnRH, FSH and LH and their glycoprotein hormone receptors, unlike neighbours centred on gonadotropin secretion, activin and gonadal development.

head: Alpha-2 adrenergic inhibitory signaling
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic inhibitory signaling (Gi/Gz adenylate cyclase inhibition, catecholamine release, insulin secretion)
rationale: Alpha-2 adrenoceptors couple through Gi/Gz to inhibit adenylate cyclase and suppress catecholamine and insulin secretion; the secretion arm and Gz separate it from generic cAMP and adrenoceptor neighbours.

head: Gap junction coupling in cardiac conduction
name: Gap junction coupling in cardiac conduction
rationale: All members concern electrical coupling via gap junctions in cardiac conduction, which no neighbour (depolarisation, conduction system development) covers.

head: Synaptic vesicle recycling
name: Synaptic vesicle recycling (clathrin-mediated endocytosis, active zone, vesicle clustering)
rationale: Members regulate the presynaptic vesicle cycle with clathrin coat assembly and endocytosis, distinguishing it from neighbours on release, docking and priming or postsynaptic receptor trafficking.

head: 12-lipoxygenase eicosanoid synthesis
name: 12-lipoxygenase eicosanoid synthesis (hepoxilins, trioxilins, 12-HETE)
rationale: All members are 12-lipoxygenase products of arachidonate, separating it from 5-/15-lipoxygenase, lipoxin and skin-barrier lipid neighbours.

head: Cytoskeletal organelle transport
name: Cytoskeletal organelle transport (axonal and dendritic cargo, mitochondria, endolysosomes)
rationale: Members move organelles and vesicles along microtubules and actin, notably in neurons, plus endolysosome size; unlike neighbours on microtubule modification, kinesins or lysosomal fusion.

head: Stress response and survival signaling
name: Stress response and survival signaling (unfolded protein response, integrated stress response, AKT-FOXO)
rationale: Members are ER/mitochondrial unfolded protein and eIF2-kinase stress responses and AKT-FOXO survival-versus-apoptosis control; AKT-FOXO separates it from ER folding neighbours and the UPR/ISR from NRF2 neighbours.

head: Immunoregulatory cytokine signaling
name: Immunoregulatory cytokine signaling (IL-10/IL-12 families, IL-15/IL-21 on NK/NKT, interferon-lambda)
rationale: Members are IL-10/IL-20, IL-12/23/27/35, IL-15/21 and type III interferon signaling with NK/NKT regulation; IL-15/21, NK/NKT and interferon-lambda separate it from the broader Th2/IL-6 and IL-17/IL-33 cytokine neighbours.

head: Mesenchymal progenitor fate signaling
name: Mesenchymal progenitor fate signaling (TGF-beta/activin, BMP, Wnt)
rationale: Members are morphogen signals driving mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation, upstream of the osteoblast and cadherin neighbours.

head: Differentiated intestinal epithelial identity
name: Differentiated intestinal epithelial identity (CDX-driven, absorptive enterocytes, barrier maintenance)
rationale: Members mark the CDX-specified differentiated gut epithelium and its barrier (leukocyte migration is a stray member); CDX and differentiation separate it from HNF4 hepatic-intestinal, crypt stem and antimicrobial neighbours.

head: Peroxisome function
name: Peroxisome function (protein import, very-long-chain fatty acid oxidation)
rationale: Members cover peroxisome biogenesis (import, fission) and its very-long-chain beta-oxidation; combining both separates it from neighbours with only fatty acid oxidation or only import plus pexophagy.

head: Glycan elongation and sialylation
name: Glycan elongation and sialylation (N- and O-glycans, gangliosides, sialic acid synthesis)
rationale: Members build and sialylate N-, O-glycan and ganglioside chains with CMP-sialic acid supply; gangliosides and sialic acid synthesis separate it from fucosylation, nucleotide-sugar and early N-glycan neighbours.

head: Myeloid cell identity signatures
name: Myeloid cell identity signatures (circulating monocytes, resting dendritic cells, surface markers)
rationale: Members are monocyte, dendritic cell and related myeloid signatures; resting surface identity separates it from monocyte activation and antigen-presentation neighbours.

head: Pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis
name: Pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis (resolvins, protectins, maresins)
rationale: All members synthesise specialised pro-resolving mediators from DHA, EPA and DPA, unlike the arachidonate lipoxin, HETE and leukotriene neighbours.

head: Renal epithelial specialization
name: Renal epithelial specialization (podocyte filtration barrier, brush-border microvilli, albumin reabsorption)
rationale: Members build the glomerular podocyte barrier and the tubular brush border that reabsorbs albumin; the microvillus and podocyte parts separate it from glomerular vasculature/mesangium and generic polarity neighbours.

head: DNA double-strand break response
name: DNA double-strand break response (break sensing, ATM signaling, classical end joining)
rationale: Members sense breaks, recruit ATM-phosphorylated factors and repair by classical NHEJ, separating it from homologous recombination, alt-NHEJ and ADP-ribosylation neighbours.

head: Mitotic sister chromatid cohesion and separation
name: Mitotic sister chromatid cohesion and separation (centromeric cohesion, anaphase release)
rationale: Members maintain centromeric cohesion and resolve it at anaphase, unlike neighbours on cohesion establishment, APC/C or spindle checkpoint.

head: Polyubiquitin chain assembly and editing
name: Polyubiquitin chain assembly and editing (atypical K6/K27/K29 linkages, E1-E2 enzymes, deubiquitinases)
rationale: Members write and erase linkage-specific ubiquitin chains; atypical linkages and free chains separate it from NF-kB, proteasome/neddylation and E3-ligase neighbours.

head: Lipoate-dependent dehydrogenase complexes
name: Lipoate-dependent dehydrogenase complexes (protein lipoylation, 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases, glycine cleavage)
rationale: Members share lipoylated E2/DLD complexes (PDH, OGDH, 2-oxoadipate for lysine catabolism, glycine cleavage), separating it from TCA, CoA, BCKDH and GABA neighbours.

head: Eye morphogenesis
name: Eye morphogenesis (lens and anterior segment, optic cup, retinal vascular barrier)
rationale: Members build eye structures and retinal vasculature with its blood-retinal barrier, unlike neighbours on retinal neuron and photoreceptor differentiation or phototransduction.

head: Innate bacterial sensing
name: Innate bacterial sensing (TLR2/4/5-MyD88, NOD1/2, inflammasome)
rationale: Members detect bacterial cell-wall ligands via TLR-MyD88/IRAK4 and NOD1/2; having both arms separates it from TLR-only and TAK1/ALPK1 neighbours.

head: Glycolysis to lactate
name: Glycolysis to lactate (hexokinase, fructose 2,6-bisphosphate regulation)
rationale: Members are glucose fermentation to lactate and its fructose bisphosphate control (oxygen transport is a stray member), unlike the gluconeogenesis, PPP-regulation and creatine neighbours.

head: Mitotic exit
name: Mitotic exit (ESCRT-III nuclear envelope resealing, abscission, endoreduplication)
rationale: Members complete or bypass mitosis via ESCRT-III envelope sealing and abscission; ESCRT and endoreduplication separate it from contractile ring, spindle and condensation neighbours.
